entities.summary: Helmuth Wilberg was a German officer and a Luftwaffe General of the Air Force during the Second World War. He helped develop the German war strategy of blitzkrieg. He was of half-Jewish ancestry, and was given the status of Honorary Aryan by Adolf Hitler.
